title: ControlSystems LQRGainSchedule

stats.done_summary: Successfully designed and implemented a gain-scheduled LQR controller with linear interpolation between operating points (z=1-4), anti-windup for actuator saturation ±0.9, and H-infinity norm constraint < 1.0 verified across all segments. Delivered runnable simulation code and comprehensive research report with methodology, results, and figures.
